transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's readiness huddle. We have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and I need to decide whether to activate it at the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library. Before I approve a site, I need to hear from each of you on your requirements. Let's start with public health nursing on the clinical side, then pharmacy logistics on supply, and finally community outreach on access. Please share what you need so I can make an informed decision and sign off on the operational plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important clinical requirement. I received the updated county allocation list this morning from the county nurse coordinator: there are 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area, and county policy requires the Saturday session serving that group to use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. This means our clinical requirement points to Eastside Community Center as the site for this month's Saturday clinic.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: On the pharmacy logistics side, I've verified with facilities that Eastside Community Center has a validated vaccine refrigerator with capacity for 80 doses at 2-8 degrees Celsius. However, please note that pharmacy policy requires an opening temperature-log check at 08:00 before any doses can be released there. As long as that temperature check is built into the operational plan, our supply requirements can be met at Eastside.

transcript.text: On the community outreach side, I can share that Eastside Community Center's partner organization has confirmed 48 appointments beginning at 09:00 on Saturday, and they've also reserved an American Sign Language interpreter for that session. I received this confirmation directly from the partner's program director. So our access requirements are already lined up and ready at Eastside Community Center.
